name: hx1-enforce-fixed-point
description: DEC-167: a lock on B3 (fork A1) while its parent B2 is invalidated off the active chain A1..A3. EnforceBlock(B3) #1 marks A2/A3 conflicting and disconnects them, but resets nothing since B3 itself is unflagged; the ActivateBestChain after it marks B3 FAILED_CHILD, so pass 1 ends at the transient tip A1. Pass #2 resets B2/B3 and connects them; the fixed point has B3 as the tip (found by regen.py --random, seed 1 sequence 371, minimized)
